title: Omnis: El Último Ciclo

world_plan.generation_policy: Create and validate subregions incrementally; this catalog is not proof that the maps or assets already exist.

subregion_tiers.purpose: Teach movement, interaction and the region's core mechanic.
Introduce enemy combinations, traversal and short objectives.
Test builds, teamwork and elemental counters.
Combine combat, exploration and environmental hazards.
Offer multi-stage encounters and meaningful choices.
Challenge advanced mastery with optional objectives.
Deliver high-skill encounters and rare cosmetic rewards.
Region finale, boss encounter and narrative consequence.

design_rules: Each region must have a readable silhouette, palette, traversal identity, local culture, faction conflict and unique boss.
Elemental powers should enable exploration and combat without making one element universally dominant.
Competitive modes must normalize combat stats; progression unlocks options and cosmetics, not guaranteed wins.
Rewards are earned through play; no paid randomized loot boxes.
All subregions must be tested and materialized in Unreal before being described as playable.

regions.name: Valle del Despertar
regions.biome: Ancient valleys, colossal roots and luminous ruins
regions.culture: Caretakers who preserve memories in living groves
regions.core_mechanic: Restore plant structures to open routes, create cover and reveal hidden paths
regions.combat_identity: Sustain, protective growth and controlled area denial

regions.name: Cumbres del Eco
regions.biome: Glacial peaks, frozen bridges and echoing caverns
regions.culture: Clans of navigators who record history in ice
regions.core_mechanic: Freeze water, redirect sliding surfaces and stabilize temporary bridges
regions.combat_identity: Slows, defensive shaping and precise control

regions.name: Bosque de los Nombres Perdidos
regions.biome: Twilight forests, broken observatories and hidden trails
regions.culture: Keepers of forgotten names and secret paths
regions.core_mechanic: Reveal concealed marks and pass through designated shadow gates
regions.combat_identity: Feints, repositioning and brief concealment with clear counterplay

regions.name: Dominio de las Cenizas
regions.biome: Volcanic citadels, ash plains and molten foundries
regions.culture: Forge guilds rebuilding tools from the remains of prior cycles
regions.core_mechanic: Manage heat vents, ignite ancient mechanisms and time safe crossings
regions.combat_identity: Burst damage, area pressure and risk-reward windows

regions.name: Reino de las Dunas Doradas
regions.biome: Moving dunes, buried cities and canyon fortresses
regions.culture: Caravan alliances that protect wells and subterranean archives
regions.core_mechanic: Raise temporary platforms, brace structures and uncover buried routes
regions.combat_identity: Fortification, stagger and reliable frontline control

regions.name: Islas de la Tempestad
regions.biome: Floating islands, storm towers and suspended bridges
regions.culture: Pilots and signal-keepers who read the weather as a living language
regions.core_mechanic: Route energy through conductors to activate lifts and traversal nodes
regions.combat_identity: Mobility, chaining pressure and quick punish windows

regions.name: Ciudad de las Mareas
regions.biome: Tidal districts, drowned plazas and coral archives
regions.culture: Tide councils balancing trade, memory and the rising sea
regions.core_mechanic: Change water levels, steer currents and access submerged passages

regions.name: Abismo de Cristal
regions.biome: Refracting caverns, crystal forests and mirrored halls
regions.culture: Artisans who store shared knowledge in resonant crystal
regions.core_mechanic: Rotate mirrors and tune crystal resonance to redirect beams and open doors
regions.combat_identity: Precision, temporary barriers and line-of-sight tactics

regions.name: Imperio de la Raíz Antigua
regions.biome: Ancestral groves, spirit bridges and ceremonial ruins
regions.culture: Storykeepers who negotiate with echoes of earlier cycles
regions.core_mechanic: Follow spirit traces, restore memory shrines and choose which echoes to preserve
regions.combat_identity: Summoned support, awareness and team utility
regions.boss: El Ancestro de las Mil Voces

regions.name: Pantano del Crepúsculo
regions.biome: Bioluminescent marshes, spore caves and decaying temples
regions.culture: Alchemists who turn dangerous ecosystems into carefully balanced medicine
regions.core_mechanic: Filter spores, mix safe reagents and open routes by restoring ecological balance
regions.combat_identity: Damage over time, area denial and antidote counterplay

regions.name: Ciudadela Celeste
regions.biome: Skyborne terraces, sun engines and luminous sanctuaries
regions.culture: Astral archivists who debate what knowledge should survive the final cycle
regions.core_mechanic: Align light paths, reveal false walls and synchronize sun engines
regions.combat_identity: Team shielding, telegraphed bursts and reveal tools

regions.name: Nexo del Último Ciclo
regions.biome: Temporal ruins, overlapping timelines and the central Nexus
regions.culture: Cycle witnesses who protect the right of each civilization to choose its future
regions.core_mechanic: Replay short environmental states, synchronize mechanisms and inspect alternate outcomes
regions.combat_identity: Timing, controlled resets and high-skill utility with strict cooldowns
